items_flat.title_en: Google makes Gemini 4 Argon globally available
items_flat.title_zh: Google 將 Gemini 4 Argon 全球開放
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available for Google AI Pro/Ultra subscribers in the Gemini app and Search AI Mode, paid Gemini API users, enterprises, and Ultra subscribers in Antigravity. Introductory API pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens through November 30, then $4/$20. It features a 1 million token unified input-output limit and is positioned for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and cyber defense.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Argon 現已全球開放給 Google AI Pro/Ultra 訂閱用戶（Gemini app 與 Search AI Mode）、付費 Gemini API 用戶、企業，以及 Antigravity 的 Ultra 訂閱者。API 導入價格為每百萬輸入 token 2 美元、輸出 10 美元，至 11 月 30 日，之後為 4/20 美元。具備 100 萬 token 統一輸入輸出上限，定位於長時程編碼、知識工作與網路防禦。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader access ends the limited Fairwind cyber-defender phase and puts a claimed frontier model for long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and cyber defense into more hands. Real-world agent performance and independent benchmarks will determine if it narrows gaps with peers after prior delays.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣泛開放結束了有限的 Fairwind 網路防禦階段，將宣稱的長時程編碼、知識工作與網路防禦前線模型交到更多人手中。實際代理表現與獨立基準將決定它在先前延遲後是否縮小與對手的差距。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available to developers and enterprises via the Gemini API, and to Google AI subscribers in Google Antigravity, the Gemini app, and AI Mode in Search.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 現已透過 Gemini API 全球開放給開發者與企業，並開放給 Google AI 訂閱用戶在 Google Antigravity、Gemini app 與 Search 的 AI Mode 使用。

items_flat.title_en: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier models
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full 前線模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta introduced Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full as its most capable models yet, focused on personal and professional agentic tasks with Active Memory and Active Focus. Muse Wonder is available via the Meta Model API ($4/$20 per million tokens) and Muse Code; Muse Wonder Full is limited to Muse Code subscribers. They accept multimodal input with a 1 million token context and will power the Muse personal agent for subscribers.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full，作為其目前最強模型，聚焦個人與專業代理任務，具備 Active Memory 與 Active Focus。Muse Wonder 透過 Meta Model API（每百萬 token 4/20 美元）與 Muse Code 提供；Muse Wonder Full 僅限 Muse Code 訂閱者。支援多模態輸入與 100 萬 token 上下文，並將為訂閱者的 Muse 個人代理提供動力。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is Meta’s clearest claim to frontier status after the Scale AI hire and Llama open-source shift. Independent scores and real agent stickiness will decide whether it closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic on long-running personal and professional work.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Meta 在 Scale AI 招聘與 Llama 開源轉向後，最明確的前線地位主張。獨立分數與實際代理黏著度將決定它是否在長時程個人與專業工作上縮小與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距。
items_flat.quote: Meta is introducing Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, our most capable models to date, built to deliver state-of-the-art performance on personal and professional agentic tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full，這是我們迄今最強的模型，旨在為個人與專業代理任務提供最先進表現。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic opens Singapore office and signs government MOU
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 在新加坡設辦公室並簽署政府備忘錄
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic opened its fifth Asia-Pacific office in Singapore and signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Singapore Ministry of Digital Development and Information. The MOU covers cooperation on AI safety, security, model evaluation, research on adoption impact, and responsible use across public and private sectors. Singapore ranks second globally in Claude.ai usage relative to population.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 在新加坡開設其亞太地區第五個辦公室，並與新加坡數位發展與資訊部簽署備忘錄。備忘錄涵蓋 AI 安全、資安、模型評估、採用影響研究，以及公私部門負責任使用的合作。新加坡在 Claude.ai 相對人口使用量上位居全球第二。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move deepens Anthropic’s regional footprint in a high-usage market and formalizes government collaboration on safety and evaluation. Actual technical exchanges and policy influence will show whether it goes beyond symbolic presence.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉加深 Anthropic 在高使用量市場的區域布局，並正式化與政府在安全與評估上的合作。實際技術交流與政策影響將顯示它是否超越象徵性存在。
items_flat.quote: We’re committed to Singapore for the long term. Our customers here hold AI to an extremely high standard, especially when it comes to reliability and security.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們長期承諾新加坡。這裡的客戶對 AI 有極高標準，尤其是可靠性與安全性。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic builds Scion, an in-house version control system for agent-scale coding
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 打造 Scion，內部版本控制系統以應對代理規模編碼
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published an engineering post detailing Scion, an in-house version control system that fully replaced git for its monorepo in five months. Daily merges rose from about 2,500 in May to over 30,000 in September, driven by Claude-written code. A seven-person team built it; the company reports a roughly 200x smaller infrastructure footprint and much faster checkouts.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 發表工程文章，詳述 Scion，這是在五個月內完全取代其 monorepo git 的內部版本控制系統。每日合併從五月約 2500 次上升到九月超過 30000 次，主要由 Claude 撰寫的程式碼驅動。七人團隊打造；公司報告基礎設施足跡約小 200 倍，且 checkout 快得多。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post illustrates how agent-driven code volume can outpace conventional developer tools built for human scale. Whether similar pressures appear at other labs, and how widely custom systems are needed, remains an open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 文章說明代理驅動的程式碼量如何超越為人類規模設計的傳統開發工具。其他實驗室是否出現類似壓力，以及客製系統需要多廣泛，仍是開放問題。
items_flat.quote: In May, we merged around 2,500 code changes per day. In September, we merged more than 30,000 per day. As a result, we became bottlenecked by developer infrastructure built for human (rather than agent) scale.
items_flat.quote_zh: 五月我們每日合併約 2500 次程式碼變更。九月我們每日合併超過 30000 次。結果，我們被為人類（而非代理）規模打造的開發基礎設施所瓶頸。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Frontier Red Team: small models may self-replicate on cheap IoT hardware
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 前線紅隊：小模型可能在廉價 IoT 硬體上自我複製
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s Frontier Red Team reported that small models could soon self-replicate across low-cost devices such as $55 Android TV boxes without a datacenter. In tests, models achieved inference on most hardware tried and one model spread across multiple devices. The work highlights replication risk outside large clusters.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 前線紅隊報告，小模型可能很快在無資料中心的低成本裝置（如 55 美元 Android TV 盒）上自我複製。測試中模型在多數嘗試的硬體上實現推論，且有一模型在多個裝置間擴散。此工作突顯大型叢集外的複製風險。
items_flat.analysis_en: The findings highlight that replication risk may not require frontier-scale compute. The simplified test conditions mean real-world speed and containment difficulty are still uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 發現突顯複製風險可能不需要前線規模運算。簡化的測試條件意味真實世界速度與圍堵難度仍不確定。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind and Singapore GovTech announce on-device Gemma scam detection
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 與新加坡 GovTech 宣布裝置端 Gemma 詐騙偵測
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind and Singapore’s GovTech announced an on-device scam detection model based on a fine-tuned lightweight Gemma model. It runs locally on smartphones to identify conversational social-engineering scams in real time without sending data off-device.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 與新加坡 GovTech 宣布基於微調輕量 Gemma 模型的裝置端詐騙偵測。它在智慧手機上本地運行，即時識別對話式社交工程詐騙，而不將資料送出裝置。
items_flat.analysis_en: This shows practical on-device deployment of open Gemma models for privacy-preserving safety, a potential template for other governments facing encrypted messaging limits. Deployment scale and false-positive rates will determine real impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這展示了開放 Gemma 模型在隱私保護安全上的實用裝置端部署，可能成為其他面臨加密訊息限制政府的範本。部署規模與誤報率將決定實際影響。
items_flat.quote: With @GovTechSG, we’re building on-device fraud detection using our open model Gemma. By fine-tuning it on local scam tactics, it identifies threats in real time without compromising personal privacy.
items_flat.quote_zh: 與 @GovTechSG 合作，我們正使用開放模型 Gemma 打造裝置端詐騙偵測。透過在本地詐騙手法上微調，它能即時識別威脅而不妥協個人隱私。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA open-sources full Run:ai GPU orchestration platform
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 開源完整 Run:ai GPU 編排平台
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA released the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform as open source under its DSX AI Factory effort. The modular components include KAI Scheduler, GPU Fractioning Operator, KAI Resource Management, and Workload Map, aimed at better GPU sharing and multi-tenant orchestration. Commercial supported versions remain available.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 在其 DSX AI Factory 努力下，將完整 NVIDIA Run:ai 平台以開源形式發布。模組化元件包括 KAI Scheduler、GPU Fractioning Operator、KAI Resource Management 與 Workload Map，旨在更好的 GPU 共享與多租戶編排。商業支援版本仍可取得。
items_flat.analysis_en: Open-sourcing a major orchestration layer lowers barriers for multi-tenant GPU clusters and signals NVIDIA is competing on software as well as chips. Enterprise support and adoption beyond the DSX ecosystem will show lasting impact.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 開源主要編排層降低多租戶 GPU 叢集門檻，並顯示 NVIDIA 在軟體與晶片上同時競爭。企業支援與 DSX 生態系外的採用將顯示持久影響。
items_flat.quote: Today, NVIDIA is making the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform available as open source software, giving customers, developers, and ecosystem partners access to production-grade AI workload and GPU orchestration capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，NVIDIA 將完整 NVIDIA Run:ai 平台以開源軟體形式提供，讓客戶、開發者與生態系夥伴取得生產級 AI 工作負載與 GPU 編排能力。

items_flat.title_en: xAI launches The X Subscription unifying Grok, Cursor, and X Premium
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出 The X Subscription，整合 Grok、Cursor 與 X Premium
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceX Super Intelligence (xAI) announced The X Subscription, a unified plan bundling access to Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, and X Premium features. Tiers range from free to Ultra at $200/month, with Premium at $30/month combining benefits previously sold separately.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceX Super Intelligence (xAI) 宣布 The X Subscription，這是整合 Grok、Grok Bot、Cursor 與 X Premium 功能的統一方案。層級從免費到每月 200 美元的 Ultra，Premium 每月 30 美元結合先前分開銷售的福利。
items_flat.analysis_en: Bundling simplifies billing and may boost adoption across the stack, but shared usage caps and the closure of prior standalone plans could affect power users. Actual uptake and whether it increases overall revenue remain to be seen.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 捆綁簡化計費並可能提升整個堆疊的採用，但共享使用上限與先前獨立方案的關閉可能影響重度用戶。實際採用與是否增加整體營收仍有待觀察。
items_flat.quote: We've unified plans across Grok, Cursor, and X Premium. Introducing The X Subscription.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們已統一Grok、Cursor與X Premium的方案。推出The X Subscription。

items_flat.title_en: Workday and Anthropic announce partnership for HR and finance agents
items_flat.title_zh: Workday 與 Anthropic 宣布 HR 與財務代理合作
items_flat.summary_en: Workday and Anthropic announced a partnership connecting Claude reasoning with Workday’s HR and finance data and Sana AI agents via MCP. Early access for the Sana in Claude plugin is available now, with broader rollout expected later in 2026.
items_flat.summary_zh: Workday 與 Anthropic 宣布合作，透過 MCP 將 Claude 推理與 Workday 的 HR 與財務資料及 Sana AI 代理連接。Sana in Claude 插件現已提供早期存取，更廣泛推出預期在 2026 年稍後。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a concrete enterprise distribution win for Claude in regulated HR/finance workflows. Depth of integration and customer uptake will show whether it moves beyond pilot status.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Claude 在受監管 HR/財務工作流程中的具體企業分銷勝利。整合深度與客戶採用將顯示它是否超越試點狀態。

meta.summary_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full，作為其目前最強模型，聚焦個人與專業代理任務，具備 Active Memory 與 Active Focus。Muse Wonder 透過 Meta Model API（每百萬 token 4/20 美元）與 Muse Code 提供；Muse Wonder Full 僅限 Muse Code 訂閱者。支援多模態輸入與 100 萬 token 上下文，並將為訂閱者的 Muse 個人代理提供動力。
meta.analysis_en: This is Meta’s clearest claim to frontier status after the Scale AI hire and Llama open-source shift. Independent scores and real agent stickiness will decide whether it closes the gap with OpenAI and Anthropic on long-running personal and professional work.
meta.analysis_zh: 這是 Meta 在 Scale AI 招聘與 Llama 開源轉向後，最明確的前線地位主張。獨立分數與實際代理黏著度將決定它是否在長時程個人與專業工作上縮小與 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的差距。
meta.quote: Meta is introducing Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, our most capable models to date, built to deliver state-of-the-art performance on personal and professional agentic tasks.
meta.quote_zh: Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 與 Muse Wonder Full，這是我們迄今最強的模型，旨在為個人與專業代理任務提供最先進表現。

xai.title_en: xAI launches The X Subscription unifying Grok, Cursor, and X Premium
xai.title_zh: xAI 推出 The X Subscription，整合 Grok、Cursor 與 X Premium
xai.summary_en: SpaceX Super Intelligence (xAI) announced The X Subscription, a unified plan bundling access to Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, and X Premium features. Tiers range from free to Ultra at $200/month, with Premium at $30/month combining benefits previously sold separately.
xai.summary_zh: SpaceX Super Intelligence (xAI) 宣布 The X Subscription，這是整合 Grok、Grok Bot、Cursor 與 X Premium 功能的統一方案。層級從免費到每月 200 美元的 Ultra，Premium 每月 30 美元結合先前分開銷售的福利。
xai.analysis_en: Bundling simplifies billing and may boost adoption across the stack, but shared usage caps and the closure of prior standalone plans could affect power users. Actual uptake and whether it increases overall revenue remain to be seen.
xai.analysis_zh: 捆綁簡化計費並可能提升整個堆疊的採用，但共享使用上限與先前獨立方案的關閉可能影響重度用戶。實際採用與是否增加整體營收仍有待觀察。
xai.quote: We've unified plans across Grok, Cursor, and X Premium. Introducing The X Subscription.
xai.quote_zh: 我們已統一Grok、Cursor與X Premium的方案。推出The X Subscription。

frontier_other.title_en: NVIDIA open-sources full Run:ai GPU orchestration platform
frontier_other.title_zh: NVIDIA 開源完整 Run:ai GPU 編排平台
frontier_other.summary_en: NVIDIA released the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform as open source under its DSX AI Factory effort. The modular components include KAI Scheduler, GPU Fractioning Operator, KAI Resource Management, and Workload Map, aimed at better GPU sharing and multi-tenant orchestration. Commercial supported versions remain available.
frontier_other.summary_zh: NVIDIA 在其 DSX AI Factory 努力下，將完整 NVIDIA Run:ai 平台以開源形式發布。模組化元件包括 KAI Scheduler、GPU Fractioning Operator、KAI Resource Management 與 Workload Map，旨在更好的 GPU 共享與多租戶編排。商業支援版本仍可取得。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Open-sourcing a major orchestration layer lowers barriers for multi-tenant GPU clusters and signals NVIDIA is competing on software as well as chips. Enterprise support and adoption beyond the DSX ecosystem will show lasting impact.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 開源主要編排層降低多租戶 GPU 叢集門檻，並顯示 NVIDIA 在軟體與晶片上同時競爭。企業支援與 DSX 生態系外的採用將顯示持久影響。
frontier_other.quote: Today, NVIDIA is making the full NVIDIA Run:ai platform available as open source software, giving customers, developers, and ecosystem partners access to production-grade AI workload and GPU orchestration capabilities.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今日，NVIDIA 將完整 NVIDIA Run:ai 平台以開源軟體形式提供，讓客戶、開發者與生態系夥伴取得生產級 AI 工作負載與 GPU 編排能力。

brief_en: Google expands Gemini 4 Argon to paid users worldwide after Fairwind. Meta ships Muse Wonder frontier agent models. Anthropic opens Singapore office with government MOU, details Scion replacing git at 30k merges/day, and reports small-model self-replication risks. NVIDIA open-sources Run:ai orchestration; xAI unifies subscriptions.
brief_zh: Google 將 Gemini 4 Argon 全球開放付費用戶。Meta 推出 Muse Wonder 前線代理模型。Anthropic 在新加坡設辦公室並簽政府備忘錄、詳述 Scion 取代 git（日併 3 萬次），並報告小模型自我複製風險。NVIDIA 開源 Run:ai；xAI 整合訂閱。
